properties.displayName: [Baseline] Azure file shares should be protected by Azure Backup
properties.description: Audits SMB Azure file shares that have no centrally managed Azure Backup protected-item record. A share is compliant when a backup-protected item exists for it in a Recovery Services vault; this is an existence-only check and does not assess backup health, freshness, or recoverability. NFS shares are excluded because Azure Backup does not support them. Pair with Microsoft's built-in DeployIfNotExists file-share backup policies once a vault strategy is settled.

metadata.description: AuditIfNotExists reports SMB file shares without backup protection; Disabled turns the policy off.
